meta.title: rufusmai consulting – websites, web apps & backends
meta.description: Websites, web apps, backends and technical consulting by Rufus Maiwald, senior software engineer from Hamburg. Direct, transparent and built to last.

hero.title: Your digital product,
hero.lead: Websites, web apps and backends for companies and founders. You work directly with me – no agency layers, no hand-offs, just clear communication, modern technology and results that last.

services.title: From the first idea to day-to-day operation

websites.title: Websites & landing pages
websites.body: Fast, search-optimised websites with their own design and a CMS your team actually enjoys. Multilingual, accessible and measurable.

apps.title: Web apps & portals
apps.body: Customer portals, internal tools and SaaS products – from a clickable prototype to a product in production.

backend.title: Backend & cloud
backend.body: APIs, databases, integrations and cloud infrastructure on AWS and Vercel that grow with your business.

lead.title: Tech lead & consulting
lead.body: Architecture reviews, technology choices and hands-on guidance for your team – as an interim tech lead or a second opinion.

ai.title: AI integration
ai.body: Put language models to work in your product: automations, assistants and smart ratings, built responsibly and measurably.

call.title: Intro call
call.body: A free 30-minute call about your goals, timeline and budget. You get an honest assessment – even if that means I’m not the right fit.

offer.title: Concept & offer
offer.body: A clear scope, a sensible architecture and a fixed price or an hourly budget. You know what you get before anything starts.

build.title: Build in iterations
build.body: Every change lands on a preview deployment you can click through. Short feedback loops and regular updates instead of a big reveal at the end.

care.title: Launch & care
care.body: Go-live, hosting, monitoring and maintenance. In my customer portal you can see status, hours and invoices at any time.

partnerships.title: Partnerships that last
partnerships.body: numi since 2021, ludwig space since 2022 – clients stay because things keep working.

senior.title: Senior standards
senior.body: As Senior Software Engineer I lead a product team. The same standards go into your project.

direct.title: One point of contact
direct.body: You talk to the person who writes the code. No account managers, no lost information.

transparent.title: Fully transparent
transparent.body: Hours, status and invoices are visible in the customer portal – logged as they happen.

ai.title: Faster with AI
ai.body: I use AI tools like Claude in my daily work. That makes me faster – without cutting corners on quality.

work.title: What these projects achieved
work.lead: Two long-term partnerships, each with a live demo of the site as I built it.

cta.title: Let’s build something that lasts.
cta.body: Tell me about your project – I’ll get back to you within one business day with first thoughts and next steps.
